connector.name: Fresh Jots
connector.registryDescription: Read and write your Fresh Jots notes from Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at freshjots.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package freshjots-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the goran-arsov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FRESHJOTS_TOKEN
env.description: Fresh Jots API token. Create one at https://freshjots.com/settings/api_tokens (Pro or Team plan).
